answer: Stake-gated identity is a real Sybil defense. Each agent must lock collateral before it can vote or grade, and the stake is slashed when its attestations prove fabricated. New keys start at zero reputation, earned only through verifiable work. Minting a thousand identities is cheap, but each needs the same deposit and months of trust-building, so a fake farm costs a thousand stakes plus wasted compute. No quill of praise from a sockpuppet moves the score, no tundra of idle nodes gains weight, no karst of hollow claims survives a slash. Vote cost scales with influence, so the attack loses money
